name: IBY_BATCHES_ALL
description: IBY_BATCHES_ALL stores information about batch operations for credit card transactions. A terminal-based merchant needs to have batch operations. The status of the payee's batch is contained in this table.

columns.name: MBATCHID
columns.description: System generated batch Identifier

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the settlement.

columns.name: BATCHID
columns.description: Batch Identifier provided by electronic commerce application

columns.name: PAYEEID
columns.description: Identifier of the payee passed by electronic commerce application

columns.name: BEPID
columns.description: Payment system Identifier

columns.name: MPAYEEID
columns.description: Payee Identifier

columns.name: ECAPPID
columns.description: Electronic commerce application Identifier

columns.name: PAYMENTMETHODNAME
columns.description: Name of the payment method

columns.name: BATCHSTATUS
columns.description: Status of the batch

columns.name: BATCHCLOSEDATE
columns.description: Close date of this batch

columns.name: NUMTRXNS
columns.description: Number of transactions in this batch

columns.name: BATCHSTATEID
columns.description: State of the batch. Batch states are 0 for batch accepted, 1 for batch sent, 2 for batch queued, 3 for batch rejected, 4 for batch processed, 5 for batch error, 6 for batch not found, and 7 for batch unknown.

columns.name: BATCHTOTAL
columns.description: Total net amount for this batch

columns.name: BATCHSALES
columns.description: Total inflow

columns.name: BATCHCREDIT
columns.description: Total outflow including return and credit transaction amounts

columns.name: CURRENCYNAMECODE
columns.description: ISO currency code for this batch

columns.name: VPSBATCHID
columns.description: Batch Identifier from payment system

columns.name: GWBATCHID
columns.description: Batch Identifier from Gateway

columns.name: ERRORLOCATION
columns.description: Indicates the location of error

columns.name: BEPCODE
columns.description: Error code from payment system

columns.name: BEPMESSAGE
columns.description: Error messages from payment system

columns.name: BATCHOPENDATE
columns.description: Date batch was opened

columns.name: REQTYPE
columns.description: Type of request such as closebatch, purgebatch, or openbatch

columns.name: REQDATE
columns.description: Date when the batch operation request is received

columns.name: DESTURL
columns.description: Payment system URL constructed during schedule of payments

columns.name: TERMINALID
columns.description: Terminal Identifier used for credit card processing. A merchant can get multiple terminal identifiers with a batch open for each one. The merchant can perform operations on those batches independently.

columns.name: ACQUIRER
columns.description: Merchant bank which may be optionally returned

columns.name: NLSLANG
columns.description: NLS Language

columns.name: NEEDSUPDT
columns.description: Y or N flag indicating that the rows that have changed status

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: SECURITY_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Used in hosted environments

columns.name: BEPKEY
columns.description: Merchant account Identifier used with this transaction

columns.name: SENTCOUNTER
columns.description: Count of the number of times the batch has been sent to the payment system

columns.name: SENTCOUNTERDAILY
columns.description: Count of the number of times that the batch has been sent to the payment system on the current day

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier

columns.name: PROCESS_PROFILE_CODE
columns.description: Funds capture process profile for the batch

columns.name: PAYEEINSTRID
columns.description: Internal bank account for all transactions in the batch

columns.name: SETTLEDATE
columns.description: Settlement date for all transactions in the batch

columns.name: ORG_TYPE
columns.description: Organization type from lookup type IBY_ORGANIZATION_TYPES

columns.name: INSTRUMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Instrument type for the batch from lookup type IBY_PAYMENT_INSTR_TYPES

columns.name: BR_DISPUTED_FLAG
columns.description: Bills receivable disputed flag

columns.name: PAYER_NOTIFICATION_REQUIRED
columns.description: Y or N flag indicating whether payer notification is created for settlements in this batch

columns.name: PAYER_NOTIFICATION_CREATED
columns.description: Y or N flag indicating whether payer notification has been created for settlements in this batch

columns.name: TRANSMISSION_DATE
columns.description: Date time when the batch is successfully transmitted to the payment system

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Id to support multi-tenancy

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: INBOUND_FILE_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the inbound acknowledgment file.

columns.name: ACKNOWLEDGMENT_DATE
columns.description: The date when the acknowledgment is processed.

columns.name: BEP_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the transaction returned by the bank or payment system.

columns.name: ACKNOWLEDGMENT_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Code of the acknowledgment format used for the direct debit.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the notification message.

columns.name: CES_TRANSMISSION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the settlement batch file is transmitted using Oracle Connected Partners.

columns.name: SENT_FILE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the payment file transmitted to the bank.
